title: Fanta's AI slop Halloween advert is a real horror show
key_facts: Moviegoers saw a Fanta Halloween ad made with AI before a Resident Evil film screening.
The ad is part of "Fanta's Haunted Universe", developed by AI studio GRAiL for the Coca-Cola Company's Fanta brand.
Characters include a cyborg Frankenstein and a werewolf DJ; Ghostface from Scream guest stars.
The aim is an annual Halloween platform, with the story developing in future years.
The writer says almost all social media comments are negative and some people vow never to buy Fanta again.
The writer notes loud online opponents may not represent the many people who do not care either way.
quote_evidence: Developed by AI studio GRAiL, Fanta’s Haunted Universe is intended to serve as a platform that will help the brand "claim Halloween".
Almost all of the comments are negative, and there are many from people vowing to never buy Fanta again.
why_it_matters_hint: Another big brand's AI advert draws a public backlash, as Coca-Cola's AI Christmas ads did.
event_date: Cinema reactions dated 1 Oct 2026; launch date of the ad not stated.
notes: Underlying event older than 8 Oct 2026, so score lowered by 1. Opinion in the article is the writer's.
